fields.html: 1. Please select what you’ll like to register. (multiple selections are permitted, but it must pertain to the same trademark)
2. Please provide a brief description of the goods/service for which you want to register your trademark?
3. In what classes do you want to register your trademark?

fields.label: Select the Required Option
choices: Class 1 - Chemical products used in industry, science, and agriculture, including those which go to the making of products belonging to other classes
Class 2 - Paints, colorants, and preparations used for protection against corrosion.
Class 3 - Cleaning and toilet preparations such as; bleach, substances for laundry use, soaps, cosmetics, etc.
Class 4 - Industrial oils, greases, fuels, and illuminants e.g candles, fuels, etc.
Class 5 – Pharmaceuticals and other preparations for medical and veterinary purposes.
Class 6 – Unwrought and partly wrought common metals as well as simple products made of them.
Class 7 – Machines, machine tools, motors, and engines.
Class 8 – Hand-operated implements used as tools in the respective professions. E.g cutlery, electric razors, hair cutters, etc.
Class 9 – Scientific, nautical, surveying, photographic, cinematographic, optical, weighing, measuring, signaling, checking (supervision), life –saving and teaching apparatus and instruments
Class 10 – Medical apparatus, instruments, and articles.

Class 11 – Apparatus for lighting, heating, steam generating, cooking, refrigerating, drying, ventilating, water supply and sanitary purposes, air conditioning apparatus, electric kettles, gas, and electric colors, vehicle lights, and vehicle air conditioning units.
Class 12 – Vehicles; apparatus for locomotion by land, air, or water, wheelchairs, motors, and engines for land vehicles, vehicle body parts, and transmissions.
Class 14 – Precious metals, goods in precious metals not included in other classes, and jewelry, clocks, and watches.
Class 15 – Musical instruments, Stands, and cases adapted for musical instruments.
Class 16 – Paper, goods made from that material, and other requisites.
Class 17 – Electrical, thermal, and acoustic insulating materials and plastics, being for use in manufacture in the form of sheets, blocks, and rods.
Class 18 – Leather, leather imitations, travel goods not included in other classes, and saddlery.
Class 20 – Furniture and its parts and plastic goods.
Class 21 – Small, hand-operated utensils and apparatus for household and kitchen use as well as toilet utensils, glassware, and articles in porcelain.
Class 22 – Rope and sail manufacture products, padding and stuffing materials, and raw fibrous textile materials.
Class 23 – Yarns and threads for textile use.
Class 24 – Textile and textile covers for household use.
Class 26 - Dressmaker’s articles. Lace and embroidery, ribbons and braids, buttons, hooks and eyes, pins and needles, artificial flowers.
Class 27 – Products intended to be added as furnishings to previously constructed floors and walls eg carpets, rugs, mats and matting, etc.
Class 28 – Games and playthings; playing cards, gymnastic and sporting articles, decorations.
Class 29 – Foodstuffs of animal origin as well as vegetables and other horticultural comestible products which are prepared for consumption or conservation.
Class 30 – Foodstuffs of plant origin prepared for consumption or conservation as well as auxiliaries intended for the improvement of the flavor of food.
Class 31 – Land products not having been subjected to any form of preparation for consumption, live animals and plants as well as foodstuffs for animals.
Class 32 – Non – alcoholic beverages as well as beer.
Class 34 – Tobacco, Smokers articles, matches, lighters for smokers

Class 35 – Advertising; Business management; Business administration, office functions, organizations, operation and supervision of loyalty and incentive schemes, advertising services provided via the internet, production of television and radio advertisements, accounting, auctioneers, trade fairs, opinion polling, data processing, provision of business information, retail services connected with the sale of (list specific goods).
Class 36 – Services rendered in financial and monetary affairs and services rendered relative to insurance contracts of all kinds.

Class 37 – Services rendered by contractors and sub-contractors in the construction or making of permanent buildings, as well as services rendered by persons or organizations engaged in the restoration of objects to their original condition or in their preservation without altering their physical or chemical properties.
Class 38 – Telecommunications services; chat room services, email services; portal services; providing user access to the internet; radio and television broadcasting.

Class 39 – Services for the transportation of people, animals, or goods, from one place to another (by rail, road or water, air or pipeline) and services necessarily connected with such transport, as well as services relating to storing of goods in a warehouse or other building for their preservation and guarding.

Class 40 – Services not included in other classes, rendered by the mechanical and chemical processing or transformation of objects or inorganic substances. For the purposes of classification, the mark is considered a service mark only in cases where the substance or object is marketed by the person who processes or transferred it. Treatment of materials; development, duplicating, and printing of photographs; generation of electricity.
Class 41 – Services rendered by persons or institutions in the development of the mental faculties of persons or animals as well as services intended to entertain and engage the attention.

Class 42 – Services provided by persons, individually or collectively in relation to the theoretical and practical aspects of complex fields of activities; such services are provided by members of professions such as chemists, physicists, engineers, computer programmers, etc.

Class 43 –Services provided by persons or establishments whose aim is to prepare food and drink for consumption and services provided to obtain bed and board in hotels, boarding houses, or other establishments providing temporary accommodation.

Class 44 – Medical care, hygienic, and beauty care given by persons or establishments to human beings and animals. It also includes services related to the field of agriculture, horticulture, and forestry.

Class 45 – Legal services, conveyance services, security services for the protection of property and individuals, social work services, consulting services relating to health and safety; consulting services related to personal appearance, provision of personal tarot reading, dating services, funeral services, and undertaking services, fire fighting services, detective agency services
